user.title: SolarEdge Hot Water Controller
user.description:
How should the integration log in to the SolarEdge monitoring portal?

**Username and password** is recommended: the integration logs in by itself and renews its access automatically.

A **browser cookie** expires after some time and then has to be copied again.

credentials.title: Log in with your SolarEdge account
credentials.description:
Use the account you log in with at [monitoring.solaredge.com]({portal_url}). Accounts with two-factor authentication are not supported; use the cookie method for those.

The Site ID is the number in the portal URL: `.../v/s/XXXXXXX/...`. All hot water controllers of the site are found automatically.

data_description.username: Email address of your SolarEdge account
data_description.password: Stored in Home Assistant to renew the login automatically
data_description.site_id: Numeric ID from the monitoring URL: .../s/XXXXXXX/...

cookie.title: Log in with a browser cookie
cookie.description:
1. Log in to [monitoring.solaredge.com]({portal_url}) and open **Smart Energy → Hot Water**
2. Press F12 → **Network** tab → reload the page
3. Click a request to `monitoring.solaredge.com` and copy the full value of the `Cookie:` request header

The Device ID is the second number in the request `/services/m/so/load-device/site/XXXXXX/device/YYYYYYYY/state`. Leave it empty to find the devices of the site automatically.

data_description.site_id: Numeric ID from the monitoring URL: .../s/XXXXXXX/...
data_description.device_id: Optional. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
data_description.cookie: Full value of the Cookie request header (F12 → Network → request headers)

select_device.title: Choose the device
select_device.description: Several load devices were found on this site. Which one is the hot water controller?

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again
reauth_confirm.description: SolarEdge rejected the stored login. Enter the current password, or paste a fresh cookie from your browser.

data_description.cookie: Full value of the Cookie request header (F12 → Network → request headers)

reconfigure_credentials.description:
Currently configured: site **{site_id}**, device **{device_id}**.

Change the account, or **Site ID** and **Device ID** after replacing the controller. The entities keep their entity IDs and their history.

reconfigure_cookie.title: SolarEdge HWC – change configuration
reconfigure_cookie.description:
Currently configured: site **{site_id}**, device **{device_id}**.

Paste a fresh cookie when the old one has expired, or change **Site ID** and **Device ID** after replacing the controller. The entities keep their entity IDs and their history.

set_operation_mode.description: Switches the hot water controller to automatic, on, off or schedule. Unlike the standard water heater action, 'On' can be limited in level and duration.
